title: Dainty Gold Marquise & Scattered Crystal Ring
storyHtml:
A marquise crystal at the centre, with smaller stones scattered along an open band like light caught mid-motion. Delicate, a little unexpected, entirely you.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
